cases.sentence: Господь позвал ___ и говорил с ним.
cases.translation: The Lord called Moses and spoke with him.
cases.explain: Моисей is the direct object of позвал (called); an animate masculine noun takes the accusative, which equals the genitive form Моисея.

cases.sentence: Пусть он заколет молодого ___ перед Господом.
cases.translation: Let him slaughter the young bull before the Lord.
cases.explain: Бык is the direct object of заколет (will kill); an animate masculine noun forms the accusative like the genitive → быка.

cases.sentence: Пусть он заколет молодого быка перед ___.
cases.translation: Let him slaughter the young bull before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before/in front of) always governs the instrumental → Господом.

cases.sentence: Сыновья Аарона разведут на жертвеннике огонь и разложат в ___ дрова.
cases.translation: Aaron's sons will kindle a fire on the altar and lay wood in the fire.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location (in the fire, no motion) takes the prepositional → огне.

cases.sentence: Кровью окропят жертвенник, который находится у ___ в шатер собрания.
cases.translation: They sprinkle blood on the altar that is at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at/by) always governs the genitive → входа.

cases.sentence: Если кто-то из вас приносит ___ в жертву скот.
cases.translation: If anyone of you offers livestock as a sacrifice to the Lord.
cases.explain: Господь is the recipient (indirect object) of приносит (brings/offers), so it takes the dative → Господу.

cases.sentence: Пусть они разложат куски вместе с головой и жиром на ___ на горящих дровах.
cases.translation: Let them arrange the pieces, with the head and the fat, on the altar on the burning wood.
cases.explain: The preposition на marking location (on the altar, no motion) takes the prepositional → жертвеннике.

cases.sentence: Пусть он положит руки на ___ жертвы всесожжения.
cases.translation: Let him lay his hands on the head of the burnt offering.
cases.explain: The preposition на with motion (onto the head) takes the accusative; for feminine -а nouns the ending is -у → голову.

reading.ru: Пусть он положит руки на голову жертвы всесожжения, и она будет принята от его лица, чтобы совершить для него отпущение грехов.
reading.question: Why does the worshiper lay his hands on the head of the burnt offering?
options: So that it is accepted to make atonement for him
To count how many animals he owns
To mark the animal for sale
reading.correct: So that it is accepted to make atonement for him
reading.explain: The text says the offering will be accepted on his behalf, to make atonement for him.

reading.ru: Если приношение это всесожжение из крупного скота, пусть жертвующий принесет в жертву самца без изъяна.
reading.question: For a burnt offering from the herd, what kind of animal must be offered?
reading.explain: The passage requires a male (самца) without blemish (без изъяна) from the herd.

reading.ru: Пусть он заколет молодого быка перед Господом, а сыновья Аарона, священники, принесут кровь и окропят со всех сторон жертвенник, который находится у входа в шатер собрания.
reading.question: Who presents the blood and sprinkles it around the altar?
options: The person who brought the offering
reading.explain: The text says Aaron's sons, the priests, bring the blood and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar.

reading.ru: Пусть жертвующий снимет шкуру с туши жертвы всесожжения и разрежет на куски.
reading.question: After the burnt offering is killed, what is done with it next?
options: Its skin is removed and it is cut into pieces
It is washed in a river
It is buried outside the camp
reading.correct: Its skin is removed and it is cut into pieces
reading.explain: The worshiper skins the carcass of the burnt offering and cuts it into pieces.

reading.ru: Это будет всесожжение, огненная жертва, благоухание, приятное Господу.
reading.question: How is the burnt offering described in relation to the Lord?
options: A pleasing aroma to the Lord
reading.correct: A pleasing aroma to the Lord
reading.explain: It is called an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma (благоухание, приятное) to the Lord.

reading.ru: Если приношение Господу — это всесожжение из птиц, пусть он принесет в жертву горлицу или молодого голубя.
reading.question: If the burnt offering is of birds, what may be offered?
options: A turtledove or a young pigeon
reading.correct: A turtledove or a young pigeon
reading.explain: The text allows a turtledove (горлицу) or a young pigeon (молодого голубя) for a burnt offering of birds.
